review_scope: Independent source/moment review of H03 variance budget, age-profile sensitivity and consolidated READOUT. This reviewer did not author glycemia audit or age-profile calculation; reviewer did author the earlier iron/lipid audit, so its claims are not a new independent audit of that own work.

independent_source_checks.original_table: Pani Table 1, NHANES nondiabetic columns, PMC2551641
independent_source_checks.weights_meaning: Task equal age-band quotas plus inherited uniform integer years; no source counts or survey weights were substituted.
independent_source_checks.age_ge70_boundary: The >=70 source bin includes >79; applying its moments to 70–79 is unverified within-bin transport. This limitation is explicit in both final sensitivity and READOUT.

independent_arithmetic.method: Separate inline reviewer calculation: XML parsing and Fraction weights; normal-quantile mixture variance; direct signed H03 covariance equation solved by 70-step bisection rather than the author quadratic. Did not import either audit calculator or any candidate.
independent_arithmetic.distinction: 0.351616 is the fixed law SD, whereas 0.352294 averages three realized-table SDs. 0.300047 is conditional law SD, whereas 0.300575 averages fitted residual RMS. These pairs are not competing population-truth estimates.

interpretation_checks.claim: Full age-profile variance could repair H03 clinical underdispersion
interpretation_checks.verdict: Not supported; final documents correctly reject this inference. The explicit normal-profile calculation has lower total SD than the existing H03 law.

interpretation_checks.claim: Eight mean/upper-quantile pairs identify within-age SD or heteroscedastic residual variance
interpretation_checks.verdict: False without shape and predictor-composition assumptions. Final documents explicitly retain this boundary.

interpretation_checks.claim: Source age-bin variance can be combined with extra BMI/sex/glucose variance
interpretation_checks.verdict: Not without decomposition. The profile calculation correctly treats source age-bin spread as marginal over those predictors and adds only between-age mean variance.

interpretation_checks.claim: H03 residual and marginal variance are accidentally confused
interpretation_checks.verdict: No such accounting defect found. The code subtracts explained reference-band variation, and the separate signed-covariance calculation reproduces all five variance components.

interpretation_checks.claim: Arbitrary source weights or a source profile establish target improvement
interpretation_checks.verdict: Not supported. Equal task bands and uniform years are stated assumptions, not source survey replay. Clinical target accuracy is neither calculated nor certified by this source-only sensitivity.

interpretation_checks.claim: More random seeds alter the retained population law
interpretation_checks.verdict: False; final READOUT correctly says they do not. Seeds quantify conditional generation variability, not source/transport uncertainty.

readout_review.verdict: PASS after the minor constructor-mean range clarification.
readout_review.CHNS: Supplied-summary reconstruction is kept separate from new-population validity and statistical-method superiority; three R authors and statistical comparator are represented.
readout_review.HRS: Existing coefficient aggregates confirm Agent lower interaction negative in 3/3; upper point sign Agent positive 3/3 versus corrected native positive 0/3. Fixed model coefficients retain source sign. Distribution diagnosis and finite-draw uncertainty are not asserted as exhaustive causal proof.
readout_review.glycemia: All H01/H02/H03 aggregate seed effects for age, BMI before/after glucose adjustment and their attenuation are positive. Displayed constructor ranges and H03 dispersion/residual RMS match the frozen ALL_ENDPOINTS.csv. Closest endpoint is not presented as whole-dataset validation.
readout_review.iron: Readout now explicitly labels survey-weighted reference OR; A prevalence/B rank are kept as separate model-specific agreements. No universal winner is declared.
readout_review.lipids: The 0.108–0.141 interval is now labeled constructor means; not all-seed bounds. Adjusted residual relationship remains unsupported and TC reference interval crosses zero.
readout_review.HAALSI: Checked all-five-author aggregate directions: 15/15 for each main effect and 8/15 for interaction. Original 3/5 versus required4/5 stop and zero-effect weakness are retained.
readout_review.proposed_experiments: Two prospective source requirements are conditional on evidence availability. No new sampling, current-target calibration, additional agent architecture, or revision-benefit claim is authorized by the findings.
readout_review.no_new_claims: No new clinical cohort, superiority claim, reliability threshold or target-independent confirmation is introduced.

static_code_review.reads: Original XML, admitted evidence, task/spec; generator.py bytes only for provenance identity.
static_code_review.writes: Only age sensitivity JSON in this new diagnostic unit.
static_code_review.portability: Relative workspace discovery now replaces the machine-specific BUNDLE root. The archive layout is still required; source files are not promised to be public.

public_release.local_path_metadata: Current audit JSONs contain machine-absolute provenance strings. Root plans explicit sanitized public derivatives using local_archive logical references; review binds the current local files and does not silently certify a later derivative hash.
public_release.export_rule: Publish only original code, documentation, aggregate metadata and this review; exclude clinical/generated row tables, third-party full source files and local archives. Root should retain derivative-to-local-input hash mapping when sanitizing metadata.

resolved_editorial_issue: Lipid range clarified as constructor means; HRS cross-implementation signs and survey-weighted iron reference clarified before this review was sealed.
limitations_of_review: H03 and age-profile arithmetic independently recomputed; other READOUT claims checked against existing aggregate reports, not new raw-data fits or all original analyses. No review can infer true clinical transport or use-specific acceptance from these checks alone.
